title: Docs: Dedicated staged rollouts (reserved pools) overview + API examples + operator FAQ
author: Kira Thompson
description: This PR adds internal-facing documentation for Dedicated staged rollouts on reserved pools (overview, concepts, API examples, and operator FAQ). It mirrors the Confluence source-of-truth and is intended for operators/oncall + solutions/CS enabling during beta. Motivation: Dedicated rollouts are currently risky when applied pool-wide; staged rollouts introduce deterministic traffic weights, per-stage gates, and approval/auditability requirements to reduce blast radius and avoid saturating reserved capacity. Scope: (1) New overview page explaining RolloutPlan/Stages/Gates, how stage weights interact with Dedicated routing, and why we fail-safe to HOLD when metrics are missing/late; (2) API examples for create/update/approve/abort/status, including idempotency headers and pagination for audit events; (3) Operator FAQ and troubleshooting: paused rollouts, missing metrics, evaluator lag, and how to decide proceed vs rollback; (4) Links to dashboards/runbooks/ADRs used by oncall and security reviewers. Not included: customer-facing GA docs, bandit experimentation, or quality-signal gates beyond a short note on optional integration. Audience: Redwood operators (SRE/Infra), support escalation, and enterprise CS during beta enablement. References: PM-418 (initiative), ENG-5133 (docs), PM-420 (default thresholds), SUP-3981 (audit trail request).
